summary: 50-foot Aermotor lookout in Madison County, Arkansas; the Register says it was moved to its present site in the late 1960s or early 1970s and registered it in 2022.

events.note: 1940 Madison County Journal item, quoted on the NHLR page, describes a lookout six miles south of Huntsville; the Register does not link it to this tower
Register says moved to current site in the late 1960s or early 1970s; year 1971 is the earliest record at the present site, not the move date

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1940 item places a lookout six miles south of Huntsville; the 1971 survey places the station about 10 miles north. The Register's move story could reconcile them, but no source ties the 1940 tower to this site.
The 1971 survey says the property was owned by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; the Register now lists a state game management area administered by AGFC. No source explains the change.

notes_for_editor: Two WebSearch calls turned up no build record for Forum. The 1940 item is quoted on the NHLR page; the Swain Mountain tower is unverified. The Huntsville reference is Arkansas; a search hit about Huntsville, Alabama was ignored. Access and staffing are not stated, so left unset. Lead: AGFC records for the McIlroy site.
